scientific_integrity: The all-depth result has a mathematical proof and supplemental exact finite checks. No claim is made for nonradial indicators or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian groups and finite common-index subgroup chains only; classification concerns radial 0–1 indicators; older small-idempotent literature may contain equivalent special cases. The 1968 Saeki paper could not be inspected in full.
title: Sharp Fourier-algebra norm gaps for valuation-orbit idempotents
